status_at_creation: frozen specification; models not yet implemented or fitted
beta_fit: fit-partition origins with Mode_PQ(t)=1 only; x=setpoint(t)-AC(t), d=AC(t+1)-AC(t); beta_unconstrained=sum(x*d)/sum(x*x); beta=min(1,max(0,beta_unconstrained)); no intercept or other fitted parameters
beta_constraint_basis: declared simple blend between persistence and current setpoint, not a hardware time-constant claim; report unconstrained value and boundary hit
zero_denominator: B1 is unidentifiable and fails; do not invent beta or select another subset
training_boundary: fit only; validation/evaluation do not fit beta, scalers, lag, thresholds or choose models
validation_role: fixed-protocol diagnostic run and code checks; no tuning planned; any later method change needs a new protocol and test-use disclosure
main_metric: evaluation current-PQ MAE in kW, equal-weighted over UTC origin dates with PQ samples; all modes and pooled PQ metrics separately reported
additional_reporting: per-date paired B0/B_SET/B1 MAE and signed bias
post-origin setpoint/mode change strata retained as diagnostics, never inputs or filters
failed_predictions: retain sample and failure table; report coverage, do not silently drop or count a failed prediction as zero
reproducibility: repeat unchanged source/sample/protocol; beta and predictions atol=1e-10 kW, metrics atol=1e-9 kW; output fingerprints where byte-stable
interpretation: no presumed improvement; one-second logged forecast MAE does not estimate delay, max capacity, independence, cross-site performance or 90% project accuracy
